root_idea.summary: The root combines the radiance and beauty associated with gold with the movement or passing-away of a thing.
root_idea.development: From these orientations develop the senses of going, departing, being removed, and taking something away, alongside derivatives for gold, gilding, routes or doctrines, and related figurative uses.

senses.definition: To go, pass along, proceed, travel, or depart.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive verb of movement; it may take إِلَى for a destination and may describe movement in any manner or at any pace.

senses.definition: To go away, leave, or pass away; of an affliction, quality, or force, to cease or dissipate.
senses.usage_conditions: With عَنْ, the subject goes away from or ceases to affect someone or something. The sense can also be figurative, as when a force or condition disappears.

senses.definition: With بِ, to go away with, carry off, take possession of, or appropriate something.
senses.usage_conditions: The بِ construction may emphasize accompanying or carrying something away, or the resulting acquisition of it; in the Quran it can describe securing part of something previously given.

senses.definition: With بِ, to cause something to go away: to take away, remove, dispel, or make it cease.
senses.usage_conditions: This transitive construction is used for physical or abstract objects, including light and other conditions; it need not mean that the agent accompanies the object.

senses.definition: To perish or be consumed, especially in the Quranic expression concerning one’s self being overcome by grief.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom in which the going-away of the self is associated with death or ruin, rather than ordinary physical travel.

senses.definition: To make something or someone go away; to remove, dispel, or take away.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV verb used for people, afflictions, sins, sorrow, ritual impurity, and other things that can be made to disappear or cease.
The active participle of ذَهَبَ; it may be followed by إِلَى to state the destination or goal.

senses.definition: Going, departure, or passing away; in transitive use, taking something away.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun of ذَهَبَ, covering the process or result of going and, with the relevant construction, being carried away or removed.
A collective-generic noun; it may be treated as masculine or feminine in Classical Arabic and can also denote a piece of gold through a derived form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In figurative uses, to be lost, wasted, consumed, or exhausted; of the reason or heart, to forsake someone; of a person, to disappear among people; or of water, to disappear in milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A group of established figurative extensions of going-away and disappearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go into the open country and, in a tropical use, to void excrement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The excretory sense is a specialized tropical use of the construction with فِي الأَرْضِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To escape someone’s memory; to be forgotten or become unclear to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَيْهِ; the related extension includes becoming dubious, confused, or vague.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pursue a way, course, mode, or manner of conduct, and hence to adopt or hold a doctrine, opinion, or religious persuasion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes expressions with مَذْهَبٌ and ذَهَبَ إِلَى for adopting a view or creed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat one word or expression as equivalent to another, or as etymologically related to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical interpretive use concerning the relation or equivalence of expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pursue every possible method or go to the utmost degree in doing or seeking something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use of مَذْهَبٌ; it may describe exhaustive effort or an extreme degree of a quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attend to one’s own affairs or occupy oneself with them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized imperative expression meaning to betake oneself to one’s own concerns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To resemble one’s father or incline toward him in likeness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with إِلَى and فِي الشَّبَهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gild something or overlay it with gold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source explicitly applies the gilding meaning to both the Form IV and Form II derived verbs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow or adopt a particular religious persuasion or similar doctrinal position.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A late-writer usage derived from مَذْهَبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The yolk, or the entire contents, of an egg.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate Classical noun use, distinct from the precious-metal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A known measure of capacity for grain used in Yemen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional technical noun with its own plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain, variously described as weak, ordinary, or copious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical authorities differ over the quantity intended; the noun is also reported with a plural in ذِهَابٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excessive in length or tallness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival extension, especially in ذَاهِبٌ فِي الطُّولِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, time, or way of going; a destination or route.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun covering the place or time of departure and the way by which one goes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place to which one goes to relieve oneself: a privy or lavatory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional tropical use, especially associated with the dialect of the people of al-Ḥijāz.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way, course, or manner of conduct; a belief, creed, doctrine, opinion, or body of religious tenets.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun extends from a pursued course to a settled intellectual or religious position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Origin or provenance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions asking where a person’s origin is not known.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gilt, overlaid with gold, or ornamented with gold; applied to gilt skins, straps, figured garments, and adorned swords.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival/passive-participial use that can describe regular gilded patterns or ornamentation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, red in color with a yellowish or golden tinge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized color adjective; the corresponding mare is described as having a clearer color and thinner skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for the Kaʿbah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name use of the otherwise adjectival form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who gilds or applies gold ornamentation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun corresponding to the gilding sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reported name for a devil or for one who inspires vain suggestions, especially suggestions connected with acts of worship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed and disputed lexical use; it is also applied to someone who embellishes disobedience or induces obsessive doubt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause or means of doing away with, removing, or dispelling something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The attested example describes fasting as a means of dispelling excessive exultation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dazzled and bewildered on suddenly seeing much gold in a mine, with one’s reason departing and one’s eyes becoming confused.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal use describing the overwhelming effect of unexpectedly seeing gold; it is distinct from the ordinary verb of going or departing.

cautions: The Form I construction ذَهَبَ بِهِ has overlapping senses of accompanying or carrying something away and causing it to disappear; the Quranic examples support both acquisition/carrying-off and removal contexts.
The devil-related use of مُذْهِبٌ is attributed in the lexical record and its status as genuine Arabic is disputed.
